title: Business Closures due to COVID-19 Pressures and Support for Companies for Post-crisis Growth
what_it_is: Business Closures due to COVID-19 Pressures and Support for Companies for Post-crisis Growth

sections.label: Firm deregistrations and registrations
sections.summary: An average of around 3,840 firms were deregistered monthly over two years, while over 5,000 new firms were registered monthly.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Over the last two years, an average of around 3,840 firms were deregistered each month, similar to the period 2017-2019, before the COVID-19 pandemic.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: On the other hand, an average of more than 5,000 new firms were registered each month over the last two years, reflecting an increase in the total number of businesses operating in Singapore, despite the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic.

sections.label: Grow Digital and Enterprise Development Grant
sections.summary: Grow Digital helps SMEs use e-commerce platforms for global markets, and the Enterprise Development Grant encourages transformation and capabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: For example, the Grow Digital initiative helps SMEs tap on established e-commerce platforms to better access global markets, while the Enterprise Development Grant (EDG) encourages our SMEs to transform and strengthen their capabilities.

sections.label: Enterprise Sustainability Programme launch
sections.summary: Enterprise Singapore recently launched the Enterprise Sustainability Programme to support businesses, especially SMEs, in building capabilities and capturing opportunities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Enterprise Singapore recently launched the Enterprise Sustainability Programme which supports businesses, especially SMEs, to build capabilities and capture new opportunities in this exciting space.

sections.label: Outward-oriented growth sectors
sections.summary: Growth will continue to be driven by outward-oriented sectors including manufacturing, wholesale trade, finance and insurance, and ICT.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Growth will continue to be driven by outward-oriented sectors, like manufacturing, wholesale trade, finance and insurance and information and communications technology (ICT).

sections.label: Business entities ceased and formed
sections.summary: Between March 2020 and September 2021, 73,036 business entities ceased while 103,585 formed, and the Enterprise Sustainability Programme supports SMEs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Between March 2020 and September 2021, over this one-and-a-half year period, a total of 73,036 business entities have ceased while 103,585 business entities have formed.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: I have cited about digitalisation, internationalisation, innovation; and he correctly pointed out the sustainability is going to be important as a competitive advantage for our SMEs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: And indeed, we are encouraging our SMEs to integrate sustainability into their business, into their business process as a competitive advantage and to grow their capabilities in the new economy by tapping on the newly launched Enterprise Sustainability Programme.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: The Enterprise Sustainability Programme supports our SMEs in a few areas: (a) in sustainability training; (b) capability development; and (c) product development.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: And also, in the month of October, ESG launched the Enterprise Financing Scheme–Green which will then catalyse funding for our SMEs to develop green solutions and technology.
